params.body:
Two rotations, signed by the operator on 2026-09-12 with both YubiKeys. Version 8 had left the next key as a file on the Mac; version 9 moved it through, version 10 puts the update key on token 39780275 and the next key on token 39780281. No key of any agent changed. `node scripts/did-webvh.mjs verify` resolves the log.

Proposed through the control gateway under #agent-workbench.
params.title: did:webvh versions 9 and 10: both keys back on the tokens
